value_unit: passive default/physical network observation without requestNetwork
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: Lantern demonstrates that VPN default-network callbacks can obscure the physical underlay and that passive observation plus setUnderlyingNetworks avoids direct-outbound/interface failures. LumiNet rederived a NOT_VPN tracker without global actors or radio-holding requests.
invariant: only non-VPN INTERNET networks may be announced; observer failure is non-authoritative because VpnService.protect remains routing safety
negative_invariant: never request/hold a network and never make underlay metadata a second routing authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 family; underlay behavior independently rederived, no source copied

separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: OnionHop separates bridge scanner semantics from Tor runtime. LumiNet rederived bounded parallel reachability, explicitly treats fronted transports, rejects documentation/private/special-use destinations and requires all DNS answers public.
invariant: bridge diagnostics are bounded and probe only admitted public destinations
negative_invariant: remote bridge text must not become an SSRF/LAN port-scan oracle
license_note: GPL-3.0; semantics independently rederived into target-native diagnostics

value_unit: real iperf3 client protocol and protocol-specific metrics
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: The iperf peer establishes that an iperf result requires the iperf control/data protocol, not arbitrary zero-byte socket writes. LumiNet now invokes bounded iperf3 JSON mode, parses TCP retransmit/CPU and UDP jitter/loss, pins validated public DNS addresses, and requires per-operation authorization.
invariant: the child receives a numeric address admitted before execution and all resource/output budgets are bounded
negative_invariant: never equate raw socket traffic with iperf interoperability; no second DNS lookup after admission; no unauthorised sustained load
license_note: MIT; protocol semantics adopted through external iperf3 client execution, not embedded C source

value_unit: conditional ETag refresh with last-known-good validate-before-swap
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: sing-box remote rule sets use conditional fetch and preserve accepted state across 304/invalid updates. LumiNet fused that invariant into the existing richer profile mirror/backoff owner: invalid 2xx never advances freshness, ETags are source-scoped and stored only after parse acceptance, 304 preserves content.
invariant: remote payload is validated before content/freshness/validator state is advanced
negative_invariant: invalid payload or cross-origin redirect must not poison last-known-good state or leak validators
license_note: GPL-3.0 family; remote rule refresh semantics independently rederived into subscription owner

value_unit: same-socket STUN mapping comparison and evidence-bounded NAT claims
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: The V2Ray branch demonstrates multi-observation NAT traversal analysis. LumiNet implements the smaller RFC5389 truth it can safely establish: mapped address plus whether mapping changes across distinct destinations, without overclaiming cone/filter classification.
invariant: transaction/source/origin are validated and user/server destinations are public-only
negative_invariant: do not label full-cone/restricted/symmetric NAT without filtering evidence
license_note: MIT; selected STUN evidence independently implemented in target diagnostics

value_unit: small STUN client surface as a negative oracle for false precision
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: v2rayN exposes a very shallow fixed STUN test; LumiNet uses it as negative evidence not to treat a binding response alone as a NAT-type determination.
invariant: reported mapping behavior must be directly supported by observations
negative_invariant: a successful binding response alone cannot justify NAT cone/filter labels
license_note: GPL-family; selected STUN/operator evidence independently rederived

value_unit: shared special-use/documentation address deny policy for remote diagnostics/fetch
separability: standalone or target-recomposed
decision_rationale: Bridge-scan safety evidence revealed the same destination-classification invariant as subscription egress. LumiNet generalized it into one rank-0 netpolicy owner reused by both subscription fetching and diagnostics.
